title: 日本 SPring-8 同步輻射設施
summary: 以 SPring-8 的 8 GeV、1436 m 儲存環為對象，先理解高電子能量如何讓真空內波盪器的基頻直接落在硬 X 光，再拆解 SACLA 直線加速器直接注入、束團純度量測與同調分率的工程，最後推導 SPring-8-II 為何改用 6 GeV 五彎消色散晶格加阻尼扭擺磁鐵，把發射度從 2.4 nm·rad 壓到 50 pm·rad 並在同一隧道內更換整座環。
summaryEn: Using SPring-8's 8 GeV, 1436 m ring, first see how high electron energy puts the fundamental of an in-vacuum undulator directly in the hard X-ray range, then work through direct injection from the SACLA linac, bunch-purity measurement and coherent-fraction engineering, and finally derive why SPring-8-II moves to a 6 GeV five-bend achromat with damping wigglers to cut emittance from 2.4 nm·rad to 50 pm·rad while replacing the whole ring inside the same tunnel.
scope: 依公開物理原理與官方資料編寫的原創教學；步驟是可驗證的學習任務與假想算例，不是原廠配方、施工圖、設備操作許可或安全程序。數值均為教學假設，需依實際規格重算。

Steps are verifiable learning tasks and hypothetical exercises, not vendor recipes, construction drawings, operating authorisation or safety procedures. Numbers are teaching assumptions and must be recalculated for real specifications.

workedExample.title: 原創假想算例與邊界
workedExample.text: 降能換週期練習：SPring-8 一支 λ_u = 32 mm、K = 2.2 的真空內波盪器在 8 GeV（γ² = 2.45×10⁸）的基頻 λ₁ = 0.032×(1+2.42)/(2×2.45×10⁸) ≈ 2.23 Å，即 5.55 keV。SPring-8-II 降到 6 GeV（γ² = 1.38×10⁸），同一波盪器基頻變成 5.55×(6/8)² ≈ 3.12 keV。要維持 5.55 keV，可（a）維持 K = 2.2 而把週期縮到 λ_u = 32×0.5625 ≈ 18 mm，或（b）維持 32 mm 而把 (1+K²/2) 降到 3.42×0.5625 ≈ 1.92，即 K ≈ 1.36。同調分率在 1 Å（ε_r = 8 pm）：現行 ε_x = 2400 pm、ε_y = 10 pm → F_c ≈ (8/2408)×(8/18) ≈ 0.15%；升級後 ε_x = 50 pm → (8/58)×(8/18) ≈ 6.1%，提高約 40 倍，再乘上電流 100→200 mA 的 2 倍，同調通量約提高 80 倍。數值為教學假設，不代表任何實機規格。
workedExample.textEn: Lower-energy period-swap exercise: a SPring-8 in-vacuum undulator with λ_u = 32 mm and K = 2.2 at 8 GeV (γ² = 2.45×10⁸) has fundamental λ₁ = 0.032×(1+2.42)/(2×2.45×10⁸) ≈ 2.23 Å, that is 5.55 keV. After SPring-8-II lowers the energy to 6 GeV (γ² = 1.38×10⁸) the same device gives 5.55×(6/8)² ≈ 3.12 keV. To keep 5.55 keV, either (a) keep K = 2.2 and shorten the period to λ_u = 32×0.5625 ≈ 18 mm, or (b) keep 32 mm and reduce (1+K²/2) to 3.42×0.5625 ≈ 1.92, that is K ≈ 1.36. Coherent fraction at 1 Å (ε_r = 8 pm): present ε_x = 2400 pm and ε_y = 10 pm give F_c ≈ (8/2408)×(8/18) ≈ 0.15%; after the upgrade ε_x = 50 pm gives (8/58)×(8/18) ≈ 6.1%, about 40 times higher, and the current step from 100 to 200 mA doubles it again, so coherent flux rises about 80-fold. Values are teaching assumptions, not any facility's specification.

workedExample.assumptionsEn: Inputs are teaching assumptions, not measured hardware, product ratings or operating parameters; recalculate after changing the system boundary.

workedExample.sourceScopeEn: Original numerical exercise; sources support public principles and facility context, not these numbers.

stages.title: 系統邊界與物理原理
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「高電子能量與硬 X 光的系統邊界」與「發射度、阻尼扭擺磁鐵與降能的取捨」：先建立機制與定量模型，再設計驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "High electron energy and the hard X-ray system boundary" and "Emittance, damping wigglers and the trade-off of lowering energy": build the mechanism and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 高電子能量與硬 X 光的系統邊界：原理與系統邊界
steps.titleEn: High electron energy and the hard X-ray system boundary: mechanism and system boundary
steps.objective: 說明「8 GeV 儲存環（1436 m，44 單元）」如何決定日本 SPring-8 同步輻射設施的關鍵性能，並畫出其輸入、輸出與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “8 GeV ring (1436 m, 44 cells)” determines the key performance of “SPring-8 synchrotron facility”, and map its inputs, outputs and boundaries.
steps.instruction: SPring-8 選擇 8 GeV，是為了讓彎轉磁鐵的臨界能量落在數十 keV，並讓波盪器的基頻直接涵蓋 10 keV 以上的硬 X 光。代價是輻射損失隨 E⁴ 暴增：每圈損失接近 10 MeV，必須由 508.58 MHz 的射頻系統補回；周長 1435.95 m 給出 2436 個束團桶與 208.8 kHz 的迴轉頻率，4 段 30 m 長直線段則容納超長波盪器。這組邊界條件決定了射頻功率、真空腔的熱負載與整座設施的用電。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「8 GeV 儲存環（1436 m，44 單元）」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: SPring-8 chose 8 GeV so that the bending-magnet critical energy lands at tens of keV and undulator fundamentals cover hard X-rays above 10 keV directly. The price is radiation loss growing as E⁴: nearly 10 MeV per turn must be restored by the 508.58 MHz RF system; the 1435.95 m circumference gives 2436 buckets and a 208.8 kHz revolution frequency, and four 30 m straights house very long undulators. These boundary conditions fix RF power, chamber heat load and the facility's electricity use. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “8 GeV ring (1436 m, 44 cells)”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Critical energy ε_c = 0.665·E²·B = 0.665×64×0.679 T ≈ 28.9 keV.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「電子能量加倍，輻射損失也只是加倍。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在方塊圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Doubling electron energy only doubles the radiation loss." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your block diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 方塊圖標明「8 GeV 儲存環（1436 m，44 單元）」的輸入、輸出與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The block diagram shows inputs, outputs and boundaries of “8 GeV ring (1436 m, 44 cells)”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

steps.title: 高電子能量與硬 X 光的系統邊界：定量估算
steps.titleEn: High electron energy and the hard X-ray system boundary: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「8 GeV 儲存環（1436 m，44 單元）」的關鍵量，並判斷參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “8 GeV ring (1436 m, 44 cells)” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of changes when a parameter moves.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：臨界能量 ε_c = 0.665·E²·B = 0.665×64×0.679 T ≈ 28.9 keV。每圈損失 U₀ = 88.46·E⁴/ρ = 88.46×4096/39.3 m ≈ 9.2 MeV，100 mA 時 P = U₀·I ≈ 0.92 MW（未含插件磁鐵）。諧波數 h = C·f_RF/c = 1435.95×508.58×10⁶/2.998×10⁸ ≈ 2436，迴轉頻率 c/C ≈ 208.8 kHz。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Critical energy ε_c = 0.665·E²·B = 0.665×64×0.679 T ≈ 28.9 keV. Loss per turn U₀ = 88.46·E⁴/ρ = 88.46×4096/39.3 m ≈ 9.2 MeV, so at 100 mA P = U₀·I ≈ 0.92 MW before insertion devices. Harmonic number h = C·f_RF/c = 1435.95×508.58×10⁶/2.998×10⁸ ≈ 2436 and the revolution frequency is c/C ≈ 208.8 kHz. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, and state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper.
steps.observation: 如何核對：從射頻發射機的前向與反射功率算出送入束流的功率，與 U₀·I 比較；在彎轉磁鐵光束線以多片已知吸收片的穿透比反推 28.9 keV 的臨界能量；用束流電流監視器的迴轉諧波核對 208.8 kHz，並以填充圖監視器確認 2436 個桶的占用情形。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Compute the power delivered to the beam from the RF transmitter's forward and reflected power and compare with U₀·I; infer the 28.9 keV critical energy on a bending-magnet beamline from transmission ratios through several known absorbers; confirm 208.8 kHz from the revolution harmonics of the current monitor and check occupancy of the 2436 buckets with a fill-pattern monitor.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成設備規格，或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit conversion slips, treating teaching assumptions as equipment specifications, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與物理解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with a physical explanation.

Harmonic number h = C·f_RF/c = 1435.95×508.58×10⁶/2.998×10⁸ ≈ 2436 and the revolution frequency is c/C ≈ 208.8 kHz.

quiz.question: 依「高電子能量與硬 X 光的系統邊界」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "High electron energy and the hard X-ray system boundary", which statement holds?

steps.title: 高電子能量與硬 X 光的系統邊界：量測與驗證
steps.titleEn: High electron energy and the hard X-ray system boundary: measurement and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的量測，驗證「8 GeV 儲存環（1436 m，44 單元）」是否符合模型預期，並訂出允收準則。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable measurement that verifies whether “8 GeV ring (1436 m, 44 cells)” meets the model expectation, and set acceptance criteria.
steps.instruction: 從射頻發射機的前向與反射功率算出送入束流的功率，與 U₀·I 比較；在彎轉磁鐵光束線以多片已知吸收片的穿透比反推 28.9 keV 的臨界能量；用束流電流監視器的迴轉諧波核對 208.8 kHz，並以填充圖監視器確認 2436 個桶的占用情形。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成量測計畫，列出儀器、基準件或參考樣品、步驟、比較對象與允收準則，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Compute the power delivered to the beam from the RF transmitter's forward and reflected power and compare with U₀·I; infer the 28.9 keV critical energy on a bending-magnet beamline from transmission ratios through several known absorbers; confirm 208.8 kHz from the revolution harmonics of the current monitor and check occupancy of the 2436 buckets with a fill-pattern monitor. Mentor task: turn this into a measurement plan listing instruments, reference artefacts or samples, procedure, comparison baseline and acceptance criteria, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 注意干擾：把低能量環的設計經驗直接放大到 8 GeV，會低估 E⁴ 的輻射損失：射頻腔數量或冷卻不足，電流爬升到一半就因腔體過熱或射頻桶縮小而丟束。
steps.observationEn: Watch for interference: Scaling a low-energy ring design straight to 8 GeV underestimates the E⁴ radiation loss: with too few cavities or too little cooling, the current ramp stalls halfway as cavities overheat or the RF bucket shrinks and the beam is lost.
steps.failure: 驗證陷阱：只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄環境條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Verification traps: a single measurement, no traceable reference, or unrecorded environmental conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格。
steps.checkEn: Submit the measurement plan: instruments, reference, procedure, acceptance criteria and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail decision rule.

steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「8 GeV 儲存環（1436 m，44 單元）」的失效原因，提出能區分原因的檢查與矯正措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure causes of “8 GeV ring (1436 m, 44 cells)” and propose discriminating checks and corrective actions.
steps.instruction: 把低能量環的設計經驗直接放大到 8 GeV，會低估 E⁴ 的輻射損失：射頻腔數量或冷卻不足，電流爬升到一半就因腔體過熱或射頻桶縮小而丟束。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整個系統的性能、良率或安全。

Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system performance, yield or safety.

steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，並指出哪一項量測能最快確認根因、如何防止再發。

steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成設備規格，或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。

steps.title: 8 GeV 波盪器的基頻、諧波與功率密度：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Undulator fundamentals, harmonics and power density at 8 GeV: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「真空內波盪器（λ_u = 32 mm，4.5 m）」的關鍵量，並判斷參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “In-vacuum undulator (λ_u = 32 mm, 4.5 m)” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of changes when a parameter moves.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：8 GeV、γ² = 2.45×10⁸、λ_u = 32 mm：K = 2.2 時 λ₁ = λ_u(1+K²/2)/(2γ²) ≈ 2.23 Å，即 5.55 keV，第 3、第 5 諧波為 16.7 與 27.8 keV；K = 1 時基頻 12.7 keV。取 B₀ = 0.8 T（K ≈ 2.4）、L = 4.5 m（N = 140）、I = 0.1 A：總功率 P = 0.633·E²·B₀²·L·I = 0.633×64×0.64×4.5×0.1 ≈ 11.7 kW，軸上功率密度 ≈ 10.84·B₀·E⁴·I·N = 10.84×0.8×4096×0.1×140 ≈ 497 kW/mrad²。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: At 8 GeV, γ² = 2.45×10⁸ and λ_u = 32 mm: for K = 2.2, λ₁ = λ_u(1+K²/2)/(2γ²) ≈ 2.23 Å, that is 5.55 keV, with 3rd and 5th harmonics at 16.7 and 27.8 keV; for K = 1 the fundamental is 12.7 keV. With B₀ = 0.8 T (K ≈ 2.4), L = 4.5 m (N = 140) and I = 0.1 A: total power P = 0.633·E²·B₀²·L·I = 0.633×64×0.64×4.5×0.1 ≈ 11.7 kW and on-axis power density ≈ 10.84·B₀·E⁴·I·N = 10.84×0.8×4096×0.1×140 ≈ 497 kW/mrad². Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, and state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper.
steps.observation: 如何核對：磁量測台上以霍爾探針取得 B₀(g)、相位誤差與場積分；裝機後用光束線單色器掃描基頻與諧波峰位核對 K(g) 表；以前端量熱式吸收器（冷卻水流量乘溫升）量總功率，與 11.7 kW 的估計比較，並用熱像儀檢查固定光闌的溫度分佈是否與有限元素模型一致。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Obtain B₀(g), phase error and field integrals with a Hall probe on the magnet bench; after installation scan fundamental and harmonic peaks with the beamline monochromator to check the K(g) table; measure total power with a calorimetric front-end absorber (cooling-water flow times temperature rise) against the 11.7 kW estimate, and check the fixed-mask temperature map with a thermal camera against the finite-element model.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成設備規格，或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit conversion slips, treating teaching assumptions as equipment specifications, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與物理解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with a physical explanation.

steps.instruction: 磁量測台上以霍爾探針取得 B₀(g)、相位誤差與場積分；裝機後用光束線單色器掃描基頻與諧波峰位核對 K(g) 表；以前端量熱式吸收器（冷卻水流量乘溫升）量總功率，與 11.7 kW 的估計比較，並用熱像儀檢查固定光闌的溫度分佈是否與有限元素模型一致。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成量測計畫，列出儀器、基準件或參考樣品、步驟、比較對象與允收準則，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。

steps.title: 低發射度注入器與注入效率：原理與系統邊界
steps.titleEn: Low-emittance injector and injection efficiency: mechanism and system boundary
steps.objective: 說明「SACLA C 頻段直線加速器直接注入」如何決定日本 SPring-8 同步輻射設施的關鍵性能，並畫出其輸入、輸出與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Direct injection from the SACLA C-band linac” determines the key performance of “SPring-8 synchrotron facility”, and map its inputs, outputs and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 自 2020 年起 SPring-8 以相鄰的 SACLA 8 GeV C 頻段直線加速器直接注入儲存環，取代原本的 1 GeV 直線加速器加 8 GeV 增能環。直線加速器的束流歸一化發射度約 1 µm·rad，在 8 GeV 下幾何發射度只有數十 pm，比儲存環的接受度小得多，因此注入束流可以用很小的振幅進入，減少損失與對儲存束流的擾動；這也是 SPring-8-II 小孔徑真空腔與低發射度環所必需的。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「SACLA C 頻段直線加速器直接注入」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Since 2020 SPring-8 has been injected directly from the neighbouring SACLA 8 GeV C-band linac, replacing the original 1 GeV linac plus 8 GeV booster. The linac beam has a normalised emittance of about 1 µm·rad, which at 8 GeV is a geometric emittance of only tens of picometres, far below the ring acceptance, so the injected beam enters with a very small amplitude, reducing losses and disturbance to the stored beam; this is also a prerequisite for the small-aperture chambers and low-emittance ring of SPring-8-II. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Direct injection from the SACLA C-band linac”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：C 頻段 5.712 GHz 加速結構梯度取 35 MV/m（教學假設）：8 GeV 需 8000 MV/35 MV/m ≈ 230 m 的有效加速長度。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Taking a C-band 5.712 GHz structure gradient of 35 MV/m (teaching assumption), 8 GeV needs 8000 MV/35 MV/m ≈ 230 m of active length.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「注入器只要能量對了，發射度大小無關緊要。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在方塊圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "An injector only needs the right energy; its emittance does not matter." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your block diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 方塊圖標明「SACLA C 頻段直線加速器直接注入」的輸入、輸出與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The block diagram shows inputs, outputs and boundaries of “Direct injection from the SACLA C-band linac”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

steps.title: 低發射度注入器與注入效率：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Low-emittance injector and injection efficiency: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「SACLA C 頻段直線加速器直接注入」的關鍵量，並判斷參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Direct injection from the SACLA C-band linac” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of changes when a parameter moves.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：C 頻段 5.712 GHz 加速結構梯度取 35 MV/m（教學假設）：8 GeV 需 8000 MV/35 MV/m ≈ 230 m 的有效加速長度。幾何發射度 ε = ε_n/γ = 1×10⁻⁶/15 656 ≈ 64 pm·rad，儲存環接受度若為 10 nm·rad，則注入束流只佔其 0.6%；能量偏差若為 0.1%，在色散 η = 0.1 m 處對應 0.1 mm 的軌道偏移，遠小於 3% 的動量接受度。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Taking a C-band 5.712 GHz structure gradient of 35 MV/m (teaching assumption), 8 GeV needs 8000 MV/35 MV/m ≈ 230 m of active length. Geometric emittance ε = ε_n/γ = 1×10⁻⁶/15 656 ≈ 64 pm·rad; if the ring acceptance is 10 nm·rad the injected beam occupies 0.6% of it; an energy error of 0.1% at dispersion η = 0.1 m corresponds to a 0.1 mm orbit offset, far inside the 3% momentum acceptance. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, and state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper.
steps.observation: 如何核對：在傳輸線末端以螢光屏或 OTR 配合四極掃描量注入束流的發射度與能散；以儲存環 DCCT 的電流階梯和傳輸線的電荷監視器算注入效率；用逐圈 BPM 看注入束流在頭幾百圈的振盪振幅並確認阻尼；以束流損失監視器定位注入時的損失位置。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Measure injected-beam emittance and energy spread at the end of the transfer line with a screen or OTR and a quadrupole scan; compute injection efficiency from the ring DCCT current step and the transfer-line charge monitor; watch the injected beam's oscillation amplitude over the first few hundred turns with turn-by-turn BPMs and confirm damping; and locate injection losses with beam-loss monitors.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成設備規格，或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit conversion slips, treating teaching assumptions as equipment specifications, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與物理解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with a physical explanation.

steps.title: 低發射度注入器與注入效率：量測與驗證
steps.titleEn: Low-emittance injector and injection efficiency: measurement and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的量測，驗證「SACLA C 頻段直線加速器直接注入」是否符合模型預期，並訂出允收準則。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable measurement that verifies whether “Direct injection from the SACLA C-band linac” meets the model expectation, and set acceptance criteria.
steps.instruction: 在傳輸線末端以螢光屏或 OTR 配合四極掃描量注入束流的發射度與能散；以儲存環 DCCT 的電流階梯和傳輸線的電荷監視器算注入效率；用逐圈 BPM 看注入束流在頭幾百圈的振盪振幅並確認阻尼；以束流損失監視器定位注入時的損失位置。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成量測計畫，列出儀器、基準件或參考樣品、步驟、比較對象與允收準則，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Measure injected-beam emittance and energy spread at the end of the transfer line with a screen or OTR and a quadrupole scan; compute injection efficiency from the ring DCCT current step and the transfer-line charge monitor; watch the injected beam's oscillation amplitude over the first few hundred turns with turn-by-turn BPMs and confirm damping; and locate injection losses with beam-loss monitors. Mentor task: turn this into a measurement plan listing instruments, reference artefacts or samples, procedure, comparison baseline and acceptance criteria, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 注意干擾：直線加速器與儲存環的射頻相位或能量若漂移，注入束流落在射頻桶邊緣，一半以上在頭幾圈內丟失，損失打在注入段真空腔與波盪器，劑量與退磁風險同時上升。
steps.observationEn: Watch for interference: If the RF phase or energy between linac and ring drifts, the injected beam lands at the edge of the RF bucket, more than half is lost within the first turns, and the losses strike injection-section chambers and undulators, raising dose and demagnetisation risk together.
steps.failure: 驗證陷阱：只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄環境條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Verification traps: a single measurement, no traceable reference, or unrecorded environmental conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格。

steps.instruction: 直線加速器與儲存環的射頻相位或能量若漂移，注入束流落在射頻桶邊緣，一半以上在頭幾圈內丟失，損失打在注入段真空腔與波盪器，劑量與退磁風險同時上升。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整個系統的性能、良率或安全。
steps.instructionEn: If the RF phase or energy between linac and ring drifts, the injected beam lands at the edge of the RF bucket, more than half is lost within the first turns, and the losses strike injection-section chambers and undulators, raising dose and demagnetisation risk together. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system performance, yield or safety.
steps.observation: 連結機制：直線加速器的束流歸一化發射度約 1 µm·rad，在 8 GeV 下幾何發射度只有數十 pm，比儲存環的接受度小得多，因此注入束流可以用很小的振幅進入，減少損失與對儲存束流的擾動；這也是 SPring-8-II 小孔徑真空腔與低發射度環所必需的。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: The linac beam has a normalised emittance of about 1 µm·rad, which at 8 GeV is a geometric emittance of only tens of picometres, far below the ring acceptance, so the injected beam enters with a very small amplitude, reducing losses and disturbance to the stored beam; this is also a prerequisite for the small-aperture chambers and low-emittance ring of SPring-8-II.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「注入器只要能量對了，發射度大小無關緊要。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "An injector only needs the right energy; its emittance does not matter." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，並指出哪一項量測能最快確認根因、如何防止再發。

steps.title: 時間結構、束團純度與單光子計數：原理與系統邊界
steps.titleEn: Time structure, bunch purity and single-photon counting: mechanism and system boundary
steps.objective: 說明「束團純度量測與 RF 擊出」如何決定日本 SPring-8 同步輻射設施的關鍵性能，並畫出其輸入、輸出與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Bunch-purity measurement and RF knock-out” determines the key performance of “SPring-8 synchrotron facility”, and map its inputs, outputs and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 時間解析實驗需要隔離的單束團，其相鄰桶的雜散電荷必須低到 10⁻⁹ 到 10⁻¹⁰ 的純度等級。SPring-8 以時間相關單光子計數（TCSPC）量束團純度：光二極體或 APD 計數每個光子相對射頻的到達時間，建立 2436 個桶的直方圖；再以共振的 RF 擊出把不要的桶內電子激發到孔徑外。要量到 10⁻¹⁰ 的純度，統計計數必須累積到 10¹¹ 以上，所以量測時間與偵測器的計數率、死時間直接相關。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「束團純度量測與 RF 擊出」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Time-resolved experiments need isolated single bunches whose neighbouring buckets carry stray charge at the 10⁻⁹ to 10⁻¹⁰ purity level. SPring-8 measures bunch purity with time-correlated single-photon counting (TCSPC): a photodiode or APD timestamps each photon against the RF and builds a histogram over the 2436 buckets, and a resonant RF knock-out drives electrons in unwanted buckets out of the aperture. Measuring a purity of 10⁻¹⁰ requires more than 10¹¹ accumulated counts, so measurement time is tied directly to detector count rate and dead time. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Bunch-purity measurement and RF knock-out”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：APD 計數率 1×10⁶ s⁻¹、量測 1 h：總計數 3.6×10⁹，10⁻⁹ 的衛星桶平均只有 3.6 個計數，統計誤差 √3.6 ≈ 1.9（53%）。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: With an APD count rate of 1×10⁶ s⁻¹ and a 1 h measurement, the total is 3.6×10⁹ counts and a satellite bucket at 10⁻⁹ averages only 3.6 counts with a statistical error of √3.6 ≈ 1.9 (53%).
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「只要注入時只填一個桶，束團純度就自動完美。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在方塊圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Filling only one bucket at injection automatically gives perfect bunch purity." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your block diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 方塊圖標明「束團純度量測與 RF 擊出」的輸入、輸出與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The block diagram shows inputs, outputs and boundaries of “Bunch-purity measurement and RF knock-out”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

steps.title: 時間結構、束團純度與單光子計數：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Time structure, bunch purity and single-photon counting: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「束團純度量測與 RF 擊出」的關鍵量，並判斷參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Bunch-purity measurement and RF knock-out” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of changes when a parameter moves.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：APD 計數率 1×10⁶ s⁻¹、量測 1 h：總計數 3.6×10⁹，10⁻⁹ 的衛星桶平均只有 3.6 個計數，統計誤差 √3.6 ≈ 1.9（53%）。要把 10⁻¹⁰ 的純度量到 10% 的相對誤差需 100 個衛星計數，即主束團 10¹² 個計數，在 10⁶ s⁻¹ 下約需 10⁶ s；實務上必須以閘控把主束團的計數衰減 10³ 倍以上，才能在數小時內完成。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: With an APD count rate of 1×10⁶ s⁻¹ and a 1 h measurement, the total is 3.6×10⁹ counts and a satellite bucket at 10⁻⁹ averages only 3.6 counts with a statistical error of √3.6 ≈ 1.9 (53%). Measuring 10⁻¹⁰ purity to 10% relative error needs 100 satellite counts, that is 10¹² main-bunch counts, about 10⁶ s at 10⁶ s⁻¹; in practice the main-bunch counts must be gated down by more than 10³ to finish within hours. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, and state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper.
steps.observation: 如何核對：以已知純度的填充（例如先以擊出清空再故意注入微量衛星）校正 TCSPC 的時間軸與閘控效率；比較擊出前後的直方圖確認衛星桶下降幅度；核對偵測器死時間造成的堆積效應，必要時以中性密度衰減片降低計數率重複量測，純度值應不隨計數率改變。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Calibrate the TCSPC time axis and gating efficiency with a fill of known purity (clear with knock-out, then deliberately inject a trace satellite); compare histograms before and after knock-out to confirm the satellite reduction; check pile-up from detector dead time and, if needed, repeat with neutral-density attenuation at a lower count rate, where the purity value must not change with rate.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成設備規格，或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit conversion slips, treating teaching assumptions as equipment specifications, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與物理解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with a physical explanation.

knowledge.text: APD 計數率 1×10⁶ s⁻¹、量測 1 h：總計數 3.6×10⁹，10⁻⁹ 的衛星桶平均只有 3.6 個計數，統計誤差 √3.6 ≈ 1.9（53%）。要把 10⁻¹⁰ 的純度量到 10% 的相對誤差需 100 個衛星計數，即主束團 10¹² 個計數，在 10⁶ s⁻¹ 下約需 10⁶ s；實務上必須以閘控把主束團的計數衰減 10³ 倍以上，才能在數小時內完成。

Measuring 10⁻¹⁰ purity to 10% relative error needs 100 satellite counts, that is 10¹² main-bunch counts, about 10⁶ s at 10⁶ s⁻¹; in practice the main-bunch counts must be gated down by more than 10³ to finish within hours.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設；套用到實際設備前，必須重新取得規格、操作條件與不確定度。

steps.title: 時間結構、束團純度與單光子計數：量測與驗證
steps.titleEn: Time structure, bunch purity and single-photon counting: measurement and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的量測，驗證「束團純度量測與 RF 擊出」是否符合模型預期，並訂出允收準則。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable measurement that verifies whether “Bunch-purity measurement and RF knock-out” meets the model expectation, and set acceptance criteria.
steps.instruction: 以已知純度的填充（例如先以擊出清空再故意注入微量衛星）校正 TCSPC 的時間軸與閘控效率；比較擊出前後的直方圖確認衛星桶下降幅度；核對偵測器死時間造成的堆積效應，必要時以中性密度衰減片降低計數率重複量測，純度值應不隨計數率改變。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成量測計畫，列出儀器、基準件或參考樣品、步驟、比較對象與允收準則，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Calibrate the TCSPC time axis and gating efficiency with a fill of known purity (clear with knock-out, then deliberately inject a trace satellite); compare histograms before and after knock-out to confirm the satellite reduction; check pile-up from detector dead time and, if needed, repeat with neutral-density attenuation at a lower count rate, where the purity value must not change with rate. Mentor task: turn this into a measurement plan listing instruments, reference artefacts or samples, procedure, comparison baseline and acceptance criteria, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 注意干擾：偵測器的餘輝或電纜反射在主束團之後 2 ns 處產生假訊號，被誤判成衛星束團；操作人員據此加強擊出，反而把主束團的電荷也擊掉一部分，壽命與通量一起下降而純度數字沒有變好。
steps.observationEn: Watch for interference: Detector afterpulsing or cable reflections create a false signal 2 ns after the main bunch that is mistaken for a satellite; operators then strengthen the knock-out, which also removes part of the main bunch, so lifetime and flux fall while the purity figure never improves.
steps.failure: 驗證陷阱：只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄環境條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Verification traps: a single measurement, no traceable reference, or unrecorded environmental conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格。
steps.checkEn: Submit the measurement plan: instruments, reference, procedure, acceptance criteria and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail decision rule.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 以已知純度的填充（例如先以擊出清空再故意注入微量衛星）校正 TCSPC 的時間軸與閘控效率；比較擊出前後的直方圖確認衛星桶下降幅度；核對偵測器死時間造成的堆積效應，必要時以中性密度衰減片降低計數率重複量測，純度值應不隨計數率改變。
knowledge.textEn: Calibrate the TCSPC time axis and gating efficiency with a fill of known purity (clear with knock-out, then deliberately inject a trace satellite); compare histograms before and after knock-out to confirm the satellite reduction; check pile-up from detector dead time and, if needed, repeat with neutral-density attenuation at a lower count rate, where the purity value must not change with rate.

knowledge.title: 允收與不確定度
knowledge.text: 允收準則必須在量測前訂定，並與擴充不確定度一起陳述；比較基準需可追溯。
knowledge.textEn: Acceptance criteria are fixed before measuring and stated together with expanded uncertainty; the comparison reference must be traceable.

quiz.question: 要驗證「時間結構、束團純度與單光子計數」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Time structure, bunch purity and single-photon counting"?
options: 允收準則可以等看到量測數據後再決定。

optionsEn: Acceptance criteria can be decided after the measured data have been seen.

steps.instruction: 偵測器的餘輝或電纜反射在主束團之後 2 ns 處產生假訊號，被誤判成衛星束團；操作人員據此加強擊出，反而把主束團的電荷也擊掉一部分，壽命與通量一起下降而純度數字沒有變好。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整個系統的性能、良率或安全。
steps.instructionEn: Detector afterpulsing or cable reflections create a false signal 2 ns after the main bunch that is mistaken for a satellite; operators then strengthen the knock-out, which also removes part of the main bunch, so lifetime and flux fall while the purity figure never improves. steps.instruction: 同調成像、X 光光子相關光譜與奈米聚焦使用的是光束中橫向同調的部分，其比例近似為 (λ/4π)² 除以電子束與繞射項合成的相空間面積。在 1 Å 波長，λ/4π ≈ 8 pm·rad；SPring-8 現行水平發射度 2.4 nm·rad 使同調分率只有千分之幾，而 SPring-8-II 的 50 pm·rad 把它提高數十倍，這才是升級真正的驅動力，而不是總通量。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「同調分率計算（1 Å）」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Coherent imaging, X-ray photon correlation spectroscopy and nanofocusing use only the transversely coherent part of the beam, whose fraction is roughly (λ/4π)² divided by the phase-space area of electron beam plus diffraction terms. steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: F_c ≈ [ε_r/(ε_x + ε_r)]·[ε_r/(ε_y + ε_r)] with ε_r = λ/4π = 8 pm at λ = 1 Å.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「總通量不變，同調分率就不會改變。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在方塊圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。

steps.title: 同調分率、繞射極限與亮度增益：定量估算

steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「同調分率計算（1 Å）」的關鍵量，並判斷參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Coherent-fraction calculation (1 Å)” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of changes when a parameter moves.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：F_c ≈ [ε_r/(ε_x + ε_r)]·[ε_r/(ε_y + ε_r)]，ε_r = λ/4π = 8 pm（λ = 1 Å）。現行：ε_x = 2400 pm、ε_y = 10 pm（教學假設）→ (8/2408)×(8/18) ≈ 0.0033×0.44 ≈ 0.15%。SPring-8-II：ε_x = 50 pm → (8/58)×(8/18) ≈ 0.138×0.44 ≈ 6.1%，同調分率提高約 40 倍；電流 100→200 mA 再把同調通量乘 2。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: F_c ≈ [ε_r/(ε_x + ε_r)]·[ε_r/(ε_y + ε_r)] with ε_r = λ/4π = 8 pm at λ = 1 Å. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, and state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper.
steps.observation: 如何核對：在光束線以楊氏雙狹縫或針孔對掃描不同間距的條紋可見度，取得橫向同調長度並換算同調分率；與用針孔相機量到的發射度和 β 函數算出的預測值比較；以同調繞射成像的重建品質作為最終的使用者端驗證。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: On a beamline scan fringe visibility with a Young double slit or pinhole pair at several separations to obtain the transverse coherence length and convert it to a coherent fraction; compare with the prediction from pinhole-camera emittance and the β function; and use the reconstruction quality of coherent diffraction imaging as the final user-side verification.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成設備規格，或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit conversion slips, treating teaching assumptions as equipment specifications, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與物理解釋。

steps.title: SPring-8-II 整合：周長、射頻頻率與一年停機：原理與系統邊界
steps.titleEn: SPring-8-II integration: circumference, RF frequency and the one-year blackout: mechanism and system boundary
steps.objective: 說明「同一隧道換環：周長縮短 0.52 m」如何決定日本 SPring-8 同步輻射設施的關鍵性能，並畫出其輸入、輸出與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Same-tunnel ring swap: circumference shortened by 0.52 m” determines the key performance of “SPring-8 synchrotron facility”, and map its inputs, outputs and boundaries.
steps.instruction: SPring-8-II 在既有 1436 m 隧道內更換整座儲存環，目標停機期約一年。新晶格的周長 1435.428 m 比現行 1435.949 m 短 0.521 m，諧波數若維持 2436，射頻頻率必須上移；所有磁鐵與真空腔先在樑架上預組裝並完成對準，停機期只做拆舊、吊裝與連接。光束線的光源點必須保留，而降能後每支波盪器都要換成更短週期的 IVU-II 才能維持原有的光子能量範圍。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「同一隧道換環：周長縮短 0.52 m」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: SPring-8-II replaces the whole storage ring inside the existing 1436 m tunnel with a target blackout of about one year. The new lattice circumference of 1435.428 m is 0.521 m shorter than the present 1435.949 m, so with the harmonic number kept at 2436 the RF frequency must rise; all magnets and chambers are pre-assembled and aligned on girders so that the blackout covers only removal, rigging and connection. Beamline source points must be preserved, and after the energy reduction every undulator is replaced by a shorter-period IVU-II to keep its photon-energy range. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Same-tunnel ring swap: circumference shortened by 0.52 m”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: f_RF = h·c/C: present 2436×2.998×10⁸/1435.949 ≈ 508.58 MHz; new ring 2436×2.998×10⁸/1435.428 ≈ 508.77 MHz, a rise of about 184 kHz that cavity tuners and low-level RF must cover.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「隧道不變，射頻頻率就可以沿用。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在方塊圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。

steps.title: SPring-8-II 整合：周長、射頻頻率與一年停機：定量估算
steps.titleEn: SPring-8-II integration: circumference, RF frequency and the one-year blackout: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「同一隧道換環：周長縮短 0.52 m」的關鍵量，並判斷參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Same-tunnel ring swap: circumference shortened by 0.52 m” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of changes when a parameter moves.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：f_RF = h·c/C：現行 2436×2.998×10⁸/1435.949 ≈ 508.58 MHz；新環 2436×2.998×10⁸/1435.428 ≈ 508.77 MHz，上移約 184 kHz，腔體調諧與低階模濾波器都要涵蓋。波盪器：λ₁ ∝ λ_u(1+K²/2)/γ²，8→6 GeV 時 γ² 乘 0.5625，λ_u = 32 mm、K = 2.2 的基頻從 5.55 keV 掉到 3.12 keV；要維持 5.55 keV 可改用 λ_u = 18 mm（相同 K）或維持 32 mm 把 K 降到 1.36。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: f_RF = h·c/C: present 2436×2.998×10⁸/1435.949 ≈ 508.58 MHz; new ring 2436×2.998×10⁸/1435.428 ≈ 508.77 MHz, a rise of about 184 kHz that cavity tuners and low-level RF must cover. Undulators: λ₁ ∝ λ_u(1+K²/2)/γ², and going from 8 to 6 GeV multiplies γ² by 0.5625, so the 5.55 keV fundamental of λ_u = 32 mm at K = 2.2 drops to 3.12 keV; keeping 5.55 keV needs λ_u = 18 mm at the same K, or 32 mm with K lowered to 1.36. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, and state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper.
steps.observation: 如何核對：停機前用雷射追蹤儀與靜水壓水平建立隧道基準網並記錄每條光束線的光源點；樑架在組裝廠完成磁鐵中心對準後整體運入，安裝後再量一次並與基準比較；射頻腔在新頻率下做冷測與高功率老練；每支新波盪器重做 K(g) 表並在光束線掃描核對。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Before the blackout build the tunnel reference network with laser tracker and hydrostatic levelling and record every beamline's source point; align magnet centres on each girder in the assembly hall, transport it as a unit, re-survey after installation and compare with the network; cold-test and high-power condition the RF cavities at the new frequency; and remake the K(g) table of every new undulator with beamline scans.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成設備規格，或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit conversion slips, treating teaching assumptions as equipment specifications, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與物理解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with a physical explanation.

steps.title: SPring-8-II 整合：周長、射頻頻率與一年停機：量測與驗證
steps.titleEn: SPring-8-II integration: circumference, RF frequency and the one-year blackout: measurement and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的量測，驗證「同一隧道換環：周長縮短 0.52 m」是否符合模型預期，並訂出允收準則。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable measurement that verifies whether “Same-tunnel ring swap: circumference shortened by 0.52 m” meets the model expectation, and set acceptance criteria.
steps.instruction: 停機前用雷射追蹤儀與靜水壓水平建立隧道基準網並記錄每條光束線的光源點；樑架在組裝廠完成磁鐵中心對準後整體運入，安裝後再量一次並與基準比較；射頻腔在新頻率下做冷測與高功率老練；每支新波盪器重做 K(g) 表並在光束線掃描核對。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成量測計畫，列出儀器、基準件或參考樣品、步驟、比較對象與允收準則，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Before the blackout build the tunnel reference network with laser tracker and hydrostatic levelling and record every beamline's source point; align magnet centres on each girder in the assembly hall, transport it as a unit, re-survey after installation and compare with the network; cold-test and high-power condition the RF cavities at the new frequency; and remake the K(g) table of every new undulator with beamline scans. Mentor task: turn this into a measurement plan listing instruments, reference artefacts or samples, procedure, comparison baseline and acceptance criteria, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 注意干擾：若周長縮短後射頻頻率沒有同步變更，或腔體調諧範圍不足 184 kHz，束流根本無法儲存；若樑架搬運中磁鐵相對位置鬆動而沒有重新量測，閉軌畸變超過校正磁鐵能力，第一圈就找不到束流。
steps.observationEn: Watch for interference: If the RF frequency is not changed with the shorter circumference, or the cavity tuning range is short of 184 kHz, no beam can be stored at all; if magnets shift on a girder during transport and are not re-surveyed, closed-orbit distortion exceeds the correctors' reach and the first turn cannot be found.
steps.failure: 驗證陷阱：只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄環境條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Verification traps: a single measurement, no traceable reference, or unrecorded environmental conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格。
steps.checkEn: Submit the measurement plan: instruments, reference, procedure, acceptance criteria and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail decision rule.

steps.instruction: SPring-8-II 的驗收同時包含光源性能與用電：發射度 50 pm·rad、電流 200 mA、亮度提升、以及永磁彎轉磁鐵與降能帶來的電力節省。射頻功率由 U₀·I 決定，彎轉磁鐵改用永磁後磁鐵電源的用電歸零，但阻尼扭擺磁鐵增加的輻射損失要由射頻補回；交接文件必須把每一項性能指標對應到量測方法、不確定度與運轉條件，使用者設施才能據此排程。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「驗收矩陣：發射度、電流、用電」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Acceptance of SPring-8-II covers both source performance and electricity: 50 pm·rad emittance, 200 mA, the brilliance gain, and the power saved by permanent-magnet bends and the lower energy. RF power follows from U₀·I; permanent-magnet dipoles eliminate magnet power-supply consumption, but the extra radiation loss of damping wigglers must be restored by the RF; the handoff document must map every performance metric to a measurement method, an uncertainty and an operating condition before users can schedule on it. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Acceptance matrix: emittance, current, electricity”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：現行：U₀ ≈ 9.2 MeV、100 mA → 束流射頻功率 0.92 MW。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Present: U₀ ≈ 9.2 MeV at 100 mA gives 0.92 MW of beam RF power.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「升級後總用電一定下降，因為電子能量降低了。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在方塊圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。

steps.title: 綠色升級的驗收指標與交接：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Acceptance metrics and handoff of a green upgrade: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「驗收矩陣：發射度、電流、用電」的關鍵量，並判斷參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Acceptance matrix: emittance, current, electricity” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of changes when a parameter moves.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：現行：U₀ ≈ 9.2 MeV、100 mA → 束流射頻功率 0.92 MW。新環：6 GeV、等效 ρ 取 45 m（教學假設）→ U₀ = 88.46×1296/45 ≈ 2.55 MeV，加阻尼扭擺 1.2 倍 → 約 5.6 MeV，200 mA → 1.12 MW；射頻功率略增，但 88 顆電磁彎轉磁鐵各 20 kW（教學假設）共 1.76 MW 的磁鐵電力歸零，整體仍淨省。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Present: U₀ ≈ 9.2 MeV at 100 mA gives 0.92 MW of beam RF power. New ring: 6 GeV with an effective ρ of 45 m (teaching assumption) gives U₀ = 88.46×1296/45 ≈ 2.55 MeV, plus 1.2 times that for damping wigglers, about 5.6 MeV, so 1.12 MW at 200 mA; RF power rises slightly, but the 1.76 MW drawn by 88 electromagnetic dipoles at 20 kW each (teaching assumption) goes to zero, leaving a net saving. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, and state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper.
steps.observation: 如何核對：以電力計分別記錄磁鐵電源、射頻與低溫（若有）的用電並與升級前比較；用針孔相機與 LOCO 模型驗證 50 pm 的發射度，用 DCCT 驗證 200 mA 與壽命；在代表性光束線以相同光學配置量升級前後的亮度比與同調分率；把所有數據連同量測不確定度寫入交接報告。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Log magnet power-supply, RF and any cryogenic electricity separately with power meters and compare with pre-upgrade values; verify 50 pm emittance with pinhole camera and LOCO model and 200 mA with lifetime from the DCCT; measure the brilliance ratio and coherent fraction before and after on representative beamlines with identical optics; and write all data with measurement uncertainties into the handoff report.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成設備規格，或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit conversion slips, treating teaching assumptions as equipment specifications, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與物理解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with a physical explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 現行：U₀ ≈ 9.2 MeV、100 mA → 束流射頻功率 0.92 MW。新環：6 GeV、等效 ρ 取 45 m（教學假設）→ U₀ = 88.46×1296/45 ≈ 2.55 MeV，加阻尼扭擺 1.2 倍 → 約 5.6 MeV，200 mA → 1.12 MW；射頻功率略增，但 88 顆電磁彎轉磁鐵各 20 kW（教學假設）共 1.76 MW 的磁鐵電力歸零，整體仍淨省。

New ring: 6 GeV with an effective ρ of 45 m (teaching assumption) gives U₀ = 88.46×1296/45 ≈ 2.55 MeV, plus 1.2 times that for damping wigglers, about 5.6 MeV, so 1.12 MW at 200 mA; RF power rises slightly, but the 1.76 MW drawn by 88 electromagnetic dipoles at 20 kW each (teaching assumption) goes to zero, leaving a net saving.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設；套用到實際設備前，必須重新取得規格、操作條件與不確定度。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions; before applying them to real equipment, obtain the actual specifications, operating conditions and uncertainties.

quiz.question: 依「綠色升級的驗收指標與交接」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？

steps.title: 綠色升級的驗收指標與交接：量測與驗證
steps.titleEn: Acceptance metrics and handoff of a green upgrade: measurement and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的量測，驗證「驗收矩陣：發射度、電流、用電」是否符合模型預期，並訂出允收準則。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable measurement that verifies whether “Acceptance matrix: emittance, current, electricity” meets the model expectation, and set acceptance criteria.
steps.instruction: 以電力計分別記錄磁鐵電源、射頻與低溫（若有）的用電並與升級前比較；用針孔相機與 LOCO 模型驗證 50 pm 的發射度，用 DCCT 驗證 200 mA 與壽命；在代表性光束線以相同光學配置量升級前後的亮度比與同調分率；把所有數據連同量測不確定度寫入交接報告。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成量測計畫，列出儀器、基準件或參考樣品、步驟、比較對象與允收準則，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。

steps.observationEn: Watch for interference: If acceptance looks only at peak brilliance without binding it to operating conditions, users may receive a machine with a lifetime of a few hours, frequent top-ups and shutters often closed: the headline metric is met while effective beam time falls.
steps.failure: 驗證陷阱：只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄環境條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Verification traps: a single measurement, no traceable reference, or unrecorded environmental conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格。
steps.checkEn: Submit the measurement plan: instruments, reference, procedure, acceptance criteria and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail decision rule.

knowledge.text: 以電力計分別記錄磁鐵電源、射頻與低溫（若有）的用電並與升級前比較；用針孔相機與 LOCO 模型驗證 50 pm 的發射度，用 DCCT 驗證 200 mA 與壽命；在代表性光束線以相同光學配置量升級前後的亮度比與同調分率；把所有數據連同量測不確定度寫入交接報告。

steps.instructionEn: If acceptance looks only at peak brilliance without binding it to operating conditions, users may receive a machine with a lifetime of a few hours, frequent top-ups and shutters often closed: the headline metric is met while effective beam time falls. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system performance, yield or safety.
steps.observation: 連結機制：射頻功率由 U₀·I 決定，彎轉磁鐵改用永磁後磁鐵電源的用電歸零，但阻尼扭擺磁鐵增加的輻射損失要由射頻補回；交接文件必須把每一項性能指標對應到量測方法、不確定度與運轉條件，使用者設施才能據此排程。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: RF power follows from U₀·I; permanent-magnet dipoles eliminate magnet power-supply consumption, but the extra radiation loss of damping wigglers must be restored by the RF; the handoff document must map every performance metric to a measurement method, an uncertainty and an operating condition before users can schedule on it.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「升級後總用電一定下降，因為電子能量降低了。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Total electricity must fall after the upgrade because the electron energy is lower." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，並指出哪一項量測能最快確認根因、如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement that confirms the root cause fastest, and state how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測確認；只更換零件或放寬參數可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement; merely swapping parts or relaxing limits can mask the problem.
